messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - prefix-cache hit_rate drop detected in serving-prod at 2026-03-15T18:02:56Z. Severity: P2. Affected route: /v1/generate (redwood-prod-gpu). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inference/cache/hitrate?svc=prod

alice.chen: paging oncall, seeing an alert for big hit-rate delta. customer-ops, any active escalations?

customer-ops: no active customer pages yet. I can check support queue for errors.

sre-oncall: I’m on it. Initial glance: global prefix cache hit_rate dropped from 92% -> 48% over ~3m. Latency increase ~220ms p50 across the cluster. Rolling traces show higher token generation times for small inputs.

mateo.ruiz: copying. Can you paste the prometheus query you used? want to reproduce.

sre-oncall: query I used: `sum(rate(prefix_cache_hits[1m])) / sum(rate(prefix_cache_requests[1m])) by (cluster)` — run for last 30m.

priya.singh: adding context: yesterday we rolled a cache invalidation patch that touched the prefix eviction logic (PR #4312). Deployment window ended ~14:00 UTC. No immediate regressions were flagged then.

alice.chen: ok interesting. timeline: patch deployed ~14:00, stable for ~4h, then at 18:02 hit-rate tanked. Could be data/state buildup or a delayed invalidation cascade.

logs-bot: Attached recent logs (server side) for the affected pool: https://logs.redwood/streams/rca/1822509876

mateo.ruiz: grabbing logs locally now. grepping for kv lookup errors and eviction messages. running: `zgrep -h "prefix.*evict|kv.*miss|prefix.*update" /tmp/logdump/* | tail -n 200`

mateo.ruiz: quick snippet from the logs:
```
[18:01:59Z] INFO cache.prefix: evicting prefix=user:session:abc123 reason=ttl
[18:02:05Z] WARN cache.kv: miss key=user:session:abc123 backend=kv-store-3
[18:02:06Z] INFO cache.rewarm: schedule rewarm prefix=user:session:abc*
[18:02:07Z] ERROR cache.kv: reuse-mismatch key=user:session:abc123 expected_owner=shard-12 found_owner=shard-7
[18:02:10Z] WARN cache.metrics: prefix_hit_rate=0.42 window=60s cluster=prod
```

priya.singh: that `reuse-mismatch` log is new. Our change introduced a best-effort shard reassignment for prefixes to reduce hotshards — if KV ownership metadata is stale we could see misses plus failed reuse attempts.

alice.chen: hypothesis 1: ownership metadata drift -> failed KV reuse -> cache thrash + rewarms -> hit-rate drop. Hypothesis 2: invalidation job overbroad (pattern matched too wide) -> mass evictions.

sre-oncall: rank hypotheses and immediate mitigations: H1 (ownership drift) high probability. Mitigation: disable reassignment in-flight and revert spool that writes the ownership claims, roll to prior config. H2 (overbroad invalidation) medium. Mitigation: pause invalidation job and throttle rewarms.

eng-lead: we should avoid a full rollback if possible. Can we flip the reassignment flag off via runtime config?

priya.singh: yes, there’s a runtime toggle: `cache.reassignment.enabled` in config service. I can flip to false now.

priya.singh: flipping `cache.reassignment.enabled=false` -> applied to all prod pools (rolling).

incident-bot: ACTION TAKEN by priya.singh at 2026-03-15T18:06:12Z: runtime toggle applied. Notifying downstream services.

mateo.ruiz: after the toggle: re-querying hit-rate. Current: 18:08 UTC window shows hit_rate increased to ~70% from 48%. Latency p50 trending down ~120ms improvement.

alice.chen: good. continue to monitor for 20m. logs-bot please attach any errors related to invalidation job.

logs-bot: invalidation job logs: `https://logs.redwood/streams/jobs/invalidation/1822509876` — showing a spike of deletes around 18:01:30Z matching prefix pattern `user:session:*` from job run id=invalidation-20260315-3

mateo.ruiz: that job did match a broader pattern than intended. Invalidation job config shows `pattern: user:session:*` but we intended `user:session:active:*`. That explains H2. Someone must have changed the pattern earlier this morning (PR #4347).

alice.chen: new info: both H1 and H2 are plausible and may have amplified each other — invalidation created mass evictions while reassignment mismatches prevented reuse and triggered rewarms. Need to capture timeline and metric deltas for RCA.

sre-oncall: collecting timeline:
- 14:00 UTC: PR #4312 deploy (reassignment feature)
- 16:40 UTC: PR #4347 deploy (invalidation pattern change)
- 18:01:20 UTC: invalidation job run -> mass delete of user:session:*
- 18:02:56 UTC: alert fired, hit-rate drop observed
- 18:06:12 UTC: reassignment toggle turned OFF (mitigation)
- 18:12:00 UTC: hit_rate partially recovered to ~78%

priya.singh: I'll own the rollback of the invalidation pattern to the intended narrower pattern. Action: revert PR #4347 or patch job config to `user:session:active:*`. ETA 45m.

alice.chen: customer impact check: any 5xx spikes or SLO breaches?

customer-ops: support queue shows ~12 users complaining about slow responses around 18:03-18:10 UTC. No 5xx errors, mostly timeouts in client SDK (timeouts set low). We should notify top customers that experienced slowness.

eng-lead: prepare a short post-incident note and notify customer success. We should include mitigation steps and ETA for full fix.

mateo.ruiz: data gathering for RCA: please attach these to the ticket:
- prefix_cache hit/miss timeseries (1m granularity) for last 12h
- per-shard reuse-mismatch counters for last 6h
- invalidation job run history and config diffs
- list of PRs touching cache pipeline since yesterday

logs-bot: exporting requested artifacts to ticket #INC-4129. Links:
- metrics: https://dash.redwood/query/INC-4129/metrics
- logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/rca/1822509876/export
- job history: https://jobs.redwood/runs/invalidation?since=2026-03-14

sre-oncall: handoff plan: I need to go offline in ~25m. @mateo.ruiz can you continue the RCA and the rollback of the invalidation job? I'll leave monitoring alerts at tighter thresholds and keep channel muted but reachable.

mateo.ruiz: I’ll take over. Plan: 1) patch invalidation job to narrow pattern (hotfix), 2) run a canary invalidation on a small subset, 3) monitor hit-rate and reuse-mismatch counters, 4) if stable, deploy to full population.

priya.singh: I’ll assist mateo with the job patch and ensure runtime toggles are documented. Also creating a fail-safe to prevent broad patterns in future (validation check in job runner).

alice.chen: please record live timeline entries in the incident ticket with timestamps and owners. Also note customer impact and mitigation timeline.

incident-bot: NOTE: Postmortem checklist created at https://pm.redwood/incidents/INC-4129. Please fill in RCA sections: timeline, root cause, contributing factors, actions, owners, and customer comms.

customer-ops: drafting customer outreach. Can we include ETA for full fix (target +45m) and mitigation (runtime toggle completed)?

eng-lead: yes. include that we applied a runtime mitigation and are patching the invalidation job. apologize for slowness and offer to follow up with incident report.

mateo.ruiz: starting hotfix now. patch diff: change `pattern: user:session:*` -> `pattern: user:session:active:*`. will run a canary on 1% of invalidation targets (shard set s1).

mateo.ruiz: canary run started at 18:33 UTC against shard s1. monitoring hit-rate for s1 vs s2.

sre-oncall: leaving handoff: transferring pager to mateo.ruiz. I will remain on-call for urgent paging escalation.

mateo.ruiz: canary looks good: s1 hit_rate steady ~90%, reuse-mismatch counters for s1 near zero. rolling patch to full population now.

priya.singh: I’ll assist mateo with the job patch and ensure runtime toggles are documented. Also creating a fail-safe to prevent broad patterns in future (validation check in job runner).

logs-bot: full rollout logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/jobs/invalidation/1822509876/rollout

mateo.ruiz: rollout complete at 18:48 UTC. global hit_rate back to ~91%. reuse-mismatch errors dropped to baseline.

alice.chen: excellent. marking incident as mitigated. Next steps for RCA:
- root cause: combo of overbroad invalidation pattern (PR #4347) + stale ownership metadata from reassignment feature (PR #4312) -> mass evictions + failed reuse.
- immediate actions: runtime toggle for reassignment (done), invalidation job patch (done), tighten job validators (todo).
- long-term: add pre-deploy simulation for invalidation jobs, add ownership metadata consistency checks, improve alerting to correlate rewarm spikes with invalidations.

priya.singh: will own long-term tasks: ticket INC-4129 -> label `rca-actions`, ETA initial remediation docs by EOD.

eng-lead: I'll review and sign off on the postmortem once the timeline is complete. Great job on quick mitigation and coordinated handoff.

customer-ops: sending customers notice now referencing INC-4129 and estimated fix time.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 2026-03-15T18:48:00Z. Close out when postmortem is filled.

alice.chen: closing thread for live coordination. If any regressions pop up, reopen here or escalate immediately. Thanks team :tada:
